marie (FinOps): Heads up team 027 Pinebridge Labs renewal INV-2027-811 looks off. Platform fee billed for full year but amendment shows private deployment effective 2027-09-10. Customer wants corrected invoice and auditor-friendly calc before renewal outreach next week.
raj (Billing): Can you paste the invoice snippet?
marie (FinOps): From the PDF: ```INV-2027-811
Line 3: Platform Fee - Period 01Jan2027-31Dec2027 - $144,000
Line 8: Support Tier: Enterprise - Period 01Jan2027-31Dec2027 - $60,000
Line 15: Migration amendment reference AMEND-59 effective 10Sep2027 - no proration applied```
priya (CS): Confirmed. Customer signed AMEND-59 on 2027-09-05; go-live 2027-09-10. Sales approved a support swap to Enterprise-Pro effective same date. CS expects platform pro-rate by days (customer requested days-based proration for auditors) and support swapped pro-rated accordingly.
tomas (Sales): Sales ops ticket SO-7182 requested pro-rate and support swap. I approved one-time manual adjustments if automation misses it.
raj (Billing): I can reproduce. Renewals job applied full-year platform + full-year Enterprise support. Automation currently does month-based proration only; the customer requested days-based and the amendment has a mid-month effective date which the job ignores. Filing billing-engine ticket.
billing-bot: New issue BE-9991 created: "renewals job ignores days-based proration and mid-month amendments" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-9991
marie (FinOps): We need a manual credit + corrected invoice now. Customer must receive docs before renewal outreach. Can billing draft the memo with explicit day-count calculation? Auditors asked for day counts.
raj (Billing): Drafting now. Doing quick math (days-based): pro-rate period Sep10-Dec31 = 113 days (Sep10-Sep30=21, Oct=31, Nov=30, Dec=31). Platform due = 144,000 * 113/365 = $44,579 (rounded). Platform credit = 144,000 - 44,579 = $99,421.
raj (Billing): Support: original billed Enterprise full year = $60,000. Enterprise-Pro annual is $84,000 (delta +$24,000). Correct approach per AMEND-59 = Enterprise for Jan9-Sep9 (252 days) + Enterprise-Pro for Sep10-Dec31 (113 days).
raj (Billing): Composite support due = (60,000 * 252/365) + (84,000 * 113/365) = 41,422 + 25,002 = $66,424 (rounded). Net support delta vs invoice = 66,424 - 60,000 = $6,424 additional due.
marie (FinOps): So net effect = platform credit 99,421 - support additional 6,424 = customer credit of $92,997. Include per-line arithmetic and rounding note for auditors.
tomas (Sales): I approve the manual credit AR-9007 up to $100k. Add my explicit sign-off to AR-9007.
ava (Finance Lead): I approve AR-9007 for $92,997. Please include AMEND-59, SO-7182, and the day-count worksheet in the credit memo.
raj (Billing): Will attach AMEND-59 PDF and SO-7182, include day-by-day calc and rounding rationale. ETA draft credit memo + corrected invoice by EOD; final after Ava signs this thread in the approvals system.
billing-bot: BE-9991 update: fix in progress; staging deployment targeted; backfill to catch past renewals scheduled for next nightly run.
priya (CS): I'll notify Pinebridge that we're issuing a corrected invoice and credit memo for contract alignment; will share the auditor-friendly calc. Avoid the word "error" in customer note.
marie (FinOps): Thanks. Once credit posts, finance will post reversal entries and update renewal calendar. Ping when BE-9991 backfill completes so we can reconcile automated runs and confirm no other day-based proration misses.
raj (Billing): Will follow up. Credit memo will show: platform 144,000 * 113/365 = 44,579; support composite calc broken down by segment and final net credit $92,997.
